data.name: Padel Rivals
data.detailed_description:
Padel Rivals, the frantic and fun arcade padel video game where you can play solo or with your friends, is here. Forget rigid simulations: here padel is played at high speed, putting the focus on what makes it so addictive: the strategy of the bounce, the adrenaline of a perfect smash and the tension of long rallies. 

Whether you're playing a quick casual match with friends on the couch or fighting for the number one spot in world leagues, the court is yours.

FROM THE PADEL COURT TO YOUR SCREEN

We've captured the essence of padel in a gameplay system that's easy to learn but hard to master. It's not just about hitting the ball, it's about positioning yourself well, timing your shots and using the glass walls as your best ally. Pull off chiquitas, aggressive volleys and the spectacular back-wall boast to overcome your opponents.

THE MULTIPLAYER ARCADE REVOLUTION

Play with up to 4 friends in chaotic and fun matches, whether in local co-op or versus mode, or showcase your skills in online multiplayer and compete in a full ranking system to become the best in the world.

NARRATIVE CAREER MODE IN NOVA VISTA

Beyond the matches, Padel Rivals offers a deep narrative career mode. You start as a rookie on the worn urban courts of El Muelle and the Underground. With each victory and rivalry, you'll climb the ranks of the Padel Rivals League, all the way to the flawless glass courts of professional stadiums in the heart of Nova Vista.

DEFINE YOUR OWN STYLE

Your player is entirely yours. Create your avatar, forge your reputation and discover the story behind the city's passion for this sport. Unlock hundreds of cosmetic items, from streetwear urban clothing to professional outfits and paddles with unique designs. Our progression system is balanced: improve your appearance and your performance, but it will never be pay-to-win.

KEY FEATURES

  • Arcade padel action: Fast-paced gameplay that prioritizes fun, reflexes and tactical positioning over complex simulation controls.

  • Narrative career mode: Rise from rookie to hero in the vibrant city of Nova Vista, facing unique rivals and challenges.

  • Online multiplayer leagues: Compete in a full ranking system and prove you are the best player in the world.

  • Local multiplayer: Play with up to 4 friends in chaotic and fun matches, whether in local co-op or versus mode.

  • Deep customization: Create a unique avatar with hundreds of unlockable paddles, clothing and accessories.

  • Stylized-realistic graphics: A distinctive art style that blends the energy of arcade games with the physics of the real sport.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD A4-9120 RADEON R3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or AMD Radeon R3
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
